interpretation: One frozen validation-best checkpoint per regular query polynomial degree, using the first held-out sequence at layer 8 / head 1 (zero-based indices 7 / 0). Measure pre-attention RMSNorm input norms, coefficient-vector norms, projections, alignment, and tanh saturation through the native Mosaic forward pass. No optimizer state is restored, no gradient is computed, and no parameter is updated.
